headline: Non-US Growth and New Businesses Offset by US Pricing and Margin Pressures

highlights: Business performance: Alkem’s revenue rose 13.8% YoY to Rs45.5bn in Q2FY27, helped by the consolidation of Occlutech from 16 July.
US sales grew just 2.4% to Rs7.8bn, as volume growth of over 10% was largely absorbed by ~16% price erosion on a single product.
Gross margin expanded 218 bps to 67.2%, but EBITDA margin slipped 49 bps to 22.5% on Enzene’s CDMO operating costs and the Occlutech acquisition.
EBITDA grew 11.3% to Rs10.3bn while net profit fell 11.7% to Rs6.8bn.
valuation: Valuation offers reasonable upside, with key monitorables being US pricing and launches, Daman resolution, non- US growth sustainability, Enzene’s commercial traction and Occlutech’s US progress.
Valuation: We maintain HOLD with a revised target price of ₹5,681/share (earlier ₹5,952), valuing Alkem at 26x Sep’28E EPS.
The target price reduction reflects near- term earnings pressure from US pricing erosion, delayed launches and continued investments in Enzene and Occlutech.
watch: Outlook: We expect healthy H2 revenue growth, supported by non-US markets and Occlutech consolidation, but margins to soften due to MIP-related costs, higher R&D and continued Enzene/Occlutech losses.
India remains the key earnings anchor, led by chronic therapies, while non-US is the fastest-growing business, albeit with some moderation ahead.
